triggers.name: session_entries_snapshot_links
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER session_entries_snapshot_links AFTER INSERT ON session_entries WHEN (SELECT backfilled_through >= watermark FROM snapshot_index_sources WHERE source = 'session-entries') BEGIN UPDATE snapshot_session_links SET children = children + 1 FROM (SELECT NEW.session_id AS session_id, NEW.seq AS seq, NEW.entry_id AS entry_id, NEW.entry_json AS entry_json, json_extract(NEW.entry_json, '$.parentId') AS parent_id, json_type(NEW.entry_json, '$.parentId') AS parent_type) AS r WHERE snapshot_session_links.session_id = r.session_id AND snapshot_session_links.entry_id = r.parent_id AND r.parent_type = 'text' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snapshot_session_links AS own WHERE own.session_id = r.session_id AND own.seq = r.seq); INSERT OR IGNORE INTO snapshot_session_links (session_id, seq, entry_id, parent_id, anchor_seq, children, broken) SELECT r.session_id, r.seq, r.entry_id, CASE WHEN r.parent_type = 'text' THEN r.parent_id END, CASE WHEN instr(r.entry_json, '"worktree_snapshot"') > 0 AND json_extract(r.entry_json, '$.type') = 'worktree_snapshot' AND json_type(r.entry_json, '$.root') = 'text' AND json_type(r.entry_json, '$.snapshotId') = 'text' THEN r.seq ELSE parent.anchor_seq END, 0, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM snapshot_session_links AS other WHERE other.session_id = r.session_id AND other.entry_id = r.entry_id AND other.seq <> r.seq) THEN 1 WHEN r.parent_type IS NULL OR r.parent_type = 'null' THEN 0 WHEN r.parent_type = 'text' AND parent.entry_id IS NOT NULL THEN parent.broken ELSE 1 END FROM (SELECT NEW.session_id AS session_id, NEW.seq AS seq, NEW.entry_id AS entry_id, NEW.entry_json AS entry_json, json_extract(NEW.entry_json, '$.parentId') AS parent_id, json_type(NEW.entry_json, '$.parentId') AS parent_type) AS r LEFT JOIN snapshot_session_links AS parent ON parent.session_id = r.session_id AND parent.entry_id = r.parent_id AND r.parent_type = 'text'; END

triggers.name: session_entries_snapshot_pending
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER session_entries_snapshot_pending AFTER INSERT ON session_entries WHEN NOT COALESCE((SELECT backfilled_through >= watermark FROM snapshot_index_sources WHERE source = 'session-entries'), 1) BEGIN UPDATE snapshot_index_sources SET watermark = NEW.rowid WHERE source = 'session-entries' AND watermark < NEW.rowid; UPDATE snapshot_index_sources SET backfilled_through = NEW.rowid - 1 WHERE source = 'session-entries' AND backfilled_through >= NEW.rowid; END

triggers.name: session_entries_snapshot_refs
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER session_entries_snapshot_refs AFTER INSERT ON session_entries WHEN instr(NEW.entry_json, '"worktree_snapshot"') > 0 AND (SELECT backfilled_through >= watermark FROM snapshot_index_sources WHERE source = 'session-entries') BEGIN INSERT OR REPLACE INTO snapshot_session_refs (session_id, seq, root, snapshot_id, prev_seq, restore_from, restore_to) SELECT r.session_id, r.seq, json_extract(r.entry_json, '$.root'), json_extract(r.entry_json, '$.snapshotId'), parent.anchor_seq, CASE WHEN json_type(r.entry_json, '$.restore.from') = 'text' AND json_type(r.entry_json, '$.restore.to') = 'text' THEN json_extract(r.entry_json, '$.restore.from') END, CASE WHEN json_type(r.entry_json, '$.restore.from') = 'text' AND json_type(r.entry_json, '$.restore.to') = 'text' THEN json_extract(r.entry_json, '$.restore.to') END FROM (SELECT NEW.session_id AS session_id, NEW.seq AS seq, NEW.entry_id AS entry_id, NEW.entry_json AS entry_json, json_extract(NEW.entry_json, '$.parentId') AS parent_id, json_type(NEW.entry_json, '$.parentId') AS parent_type) AS r LEFT JOIN snapshot_session_links AS parent ON parent.session_id = r.session_id AND parent.entry_id = r.parent_id AND r.parent_type = 'text' WHERE instr(r.entry_json, '"worktree_snapshot"') > 0 AND json_extract(r.entry_json, '$.type') = 'worktree_snapshot' AND json_type(r.entry_json, '$.root') = 'text' AND json_type(r.entry_json, '$.snapshotId') = 'text'; INSERT OR IGNORE INTO snapshot_session_records (session_id, seq, snapshot_id, hash) SELECT r.session_id, r.seq, json_extract(r.entry_json, '$.snapshotId'), json_extract(r.entry_json, link.fullkey || '.patch') FROM (SELECT NEW.session_id AS session_id, NEW.seq AS seq, NEW.entry_id AS entry_id, NEW.entry_json AS entry_json, json_extract(NEW.entry_json, '$.parentId') AS parent_id, json_type(NEW.entry_json, '$.parentId') AS parent_type) AS r, json_each(r.entry_json, '$.snapshot.chain') AS link WHERE typeof(json_extract(r.entry_json, link.fullkey || '.patch')) = 'text' AND instr(r.entry_json, '"worktree_snapshot"') > 0 AND json_extract(r.entry_json, '$.type') = 'worktree_snapshot' AND json_type(r.entry_json, '$.root') = 'text' AND json_type(r.entry_json, '$.snapshotId') = 'text'; INSERT OR IGNORE INTO snapshot_session_records (session_id, seq, snapshot_id, hash) SELECT r.session_id, r.seq, json_extract(r.entry_json, '$.snapshotId'), json_extract(r.entry_json, '$.snapshot.bundle.blob') FROM (SELECT NEW.session_id AS session_id, NEW.seq AS seq, NEW.entry_id AS entry_id, NEW.entry_json AS entry_json, json_extract(NEW.entry_json, '$.parentId') AS parent_id, json_type(NEW.entry_json, '$.parentId') AS parent_type) AS r WHERE typeof(json_extract(r.entry_json, '$.snapshot.bundle.blob')) = 'text' AND instr(r.entry_json, '"worktree_snapshot"') > 0 AND json_extract(r.entry_json, '$.type') = 'worktree_snapshot' AND json_type(r.entry_json, '$.root') = 'text' AND json_type(r.entry_json, '$.snapshotId') = 'text'; END

triggers.name: session_entries_snapshot_refs_delete
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER session_entries_snapshot_refs_delete AFTER DELETE ON session_entries BEGIN UPDATE snapshot_session_links SET children = children - 1 WHERE session_id = OLD.session_id AND children > 0 AND entry_id = (SELECT parent_id FROM snapshot_session_links WHERE session_id = OLD.session_id AND seq = OLD.seq); DELETE FROM snapshot_session_links WHERE session_id = OLD.session_id AND seq = OLD.seq; DELETE FROM snapshot_session_refs WHERE session_id = OLD.session_id AND seq = OLD.seq; DELETE FROM snapshot_session_records WHERE session_id = OLD.session_id AND seq = OLD.seq; END
